Opening connector before 'you come knowing' (a particle, an imperative, or a temporal protasis) is unrecoverable.

End-of-clause connector linking the watching-downward to the next 'in the manner of a man who...'; insufficient context.
8-char span 'rubbed off' between 'when the man rises up' and the next clause; no traces.
10-char span marked unreadable, ending the clause about the shadow extending upward; no traces survive.
Reading the line as 'his head [points] toward heaven, his feet upon the earth' — paralleling the inversion described earlier; the 1-char ⲉ likely ends ⲧⲁⲡⲉ 'head'.
Damaged sequence ⲁⲣⲡⲉ {59} ⲕⲙⲧ{60}ⲱⲃⲉ; the idiom is obscure even with editor's tentative ⲕⲙⲧⲟ ('disturbance/quake') and the 4-char gap before it has no traces.
2-char span before 'the upper region of the earth'; most likely a preposition (Lyc ⲍⲙ̄ = 'in'), giving 'in the upper region of the earth' as the limit beyond which the power does not reach.

restoration_note: This teaching unfolds the doctrine of correspondence as a mystery of inversion: the face appearing reversed in water signifies the Call descending from above into the lower (Divine accommodation downward) and, when the man rises and his face still appears below, the Answer ascending from below back to the First Man and the Living Spirit. The same logic governs all natural beings — every face, every tree, every begotten thing carries an inverted image of the higher in the lower; the soul's shadow stretching across the earth is the testimony that the body has come up out of the Deep. Most gaps were line-end fragments highly constrained by adjacent visible letters and by the teaching's own internal parallels (5008↔5022, 5009↔5018, 5003↔5031), so the bulk could be restored at high confidence — particularly the recurring formulae ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ, ⲡⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ, ⲉⲩⲁϣⲉ, ⲓ̈ⲱⲣⲙⲉ ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛ̄. Eight gaps were left unrestorable: the chapter-heading simile (1), the introducer at 5006 (12), the verb and trailing connectors of 5012 (24, 26), the rubbed/unreadable spans of 5040–5041 (56, 57), and one segment of the obscure idiom in 5042 (59) — the surviving traces (ⲁⲣⲡⲉ, ⲕⲙⲧⲱⲃⲉ) being insufficient to constrain the phrase.
